notes.title: Unsolved Stories Development Version 1.5 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We released Unsolved Stories Development Version 1.5 today.

We want to share some information and reminders right away. About a week ago, we officially kicked off the update season and announced that we'd be completing the open-world map in stages.

In a remarkably short time, we've rapidly progressed from a small beginning to a quickly expanding area. A huge thank you to everyone who supports this project – we truly appreciate it.

Full Map Planning
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32004930/5fe666947de0a380c84f2099b86fa185fa689a87.jpg

In this image, you can see the plan for the complete game map, as well as its location in Region 06 and the area it covers. Our goal is to open the entire massive map by the end of this month. We want to remind you that we're working intensely every day on object optimization and placement.


Development Version 1.5 Screenshot 1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32004930/cd94336eda2b32d9199a6c89d7556a535ce5ce22.jpg

Development Version 1.5 Screenshot 2
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32004930/a8ebe00c703668613e63f942542214df44e96f0f.jpg

It's important for players to keep this in mind: if you want to support this project, please understand that it's an unfinished game and still in the development phase.

Note: The game will continue to be developed with daily updates, and we may occasionally miss update news.

notes.title: Unsolved Stories Development Version 1.0 Update.

We're excited to announce the conclusion of a period of focused development and share an update on the project's progress. We sincerely thank everyone who has supported the game throughout this time.

Reason for the Development Pause: The primary reason for the extended period of silent development was the integration of Unreal Engine 5, which presented significant technical challenges.

New Roadmap & Visuals: We're now outlining our new roadmap, supported by visuals to illustrate our plans.
